description: EXAMPLE ONLY - not active. Shows how to route the heavy tiers to the Claude API while keeping cheap/high-volume work local. To use it: set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, then point DARCI_HOST_PROFILE at a copy of this file. Note there is currently NO Anthropic provider implementation in this repo - the model broker ships with an Ollama provider only, so adopting this profile also requires implementing the 'anthropic' provider kind.

chat.fast.note: Local and cheap - high-volume, latency-sensitive calls stay off the paid API.

chat.deep.note: The tier that most benefits from a frontier model: innovation synthesis and falsification critique.

embed.text.note: Embeddings stay local - high volume, and the vectors must stay consistent with what is already stored.

code.fast.note: Fast iteration stays local; only full synthesis pays for the API.
